description: This PHP source file defines a class `PaginationObjectHelper` responsible for creating pagination metadata and links for API responses within the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods to generate pagination responses based on request parameters and total page count.

classes.name: PaginationObjectHelper
classes.description: A helper class for constructing pagination metadata and links for API responses.

methods.name: getPaginationMeta
methods.description: Creates and returns a MetaResponse object containing total pages and records on the current page.

methods.name: getPaginationLinks
methods.description: Creates and returns a PaginationResponse object with links to first, previous, next, and last pages based on current page number.

methods.name: createPaginationLink
methods.description: Generates a URL string for a specific page number using request query parameters and URI path.
